sources.title: DOE Announces Science Applications for Quantum Computing
Physics-informed neural networks for solving derivative-constrained partial differential equations

lanes.A: Domain-to-contract map added; complete QGPA specs and application-level reference baselines remain open. DC-PINN method watch and source/data reproduction gap added; no external code run.
lanes.B: Provider-neutral integration unchanged; no SDK/hardware run.
lanes.C: Output/readout bytes, classical reconstruction, memory and transfer metrics remain separate.
lanes.D: No device/process measurement; D/G co-design preserved.
lanes.E: BIO-001 and FUS-001 unchanged; no accepted fuel, material substitution, or net-electricity evidence.
lanes.F: Full accepted-task resource/economic fields added to the contract template; no measured economic result. DC-PINN follow-up requires equal-resource training/inference and constraint-violation accounting.
lanes.G: No process window, yield, or cost-per-good-device result.
lanes.H: Official program/workflow watch published; multilingual strategic links and funding context preserved.

foundations.FND_001_to_005: No new measurement or physical mechanism.
foundations.FND_006: Domain map and DC-PINN evaluator design inform benchmark selection only; no theorem or physical mechanism.
foundations.EQN_001_to_006: No equation promoted; derivative constraints are evaluation fields, not proof of a governing law.

invariants.INV_025_026_027: Preserved; moonshots remain falsifiable and evidence-gated.
invariants.INV_029_to_035: Preserved; no mission, physical-law, fuel, fusion, material, finance, or QPU-advantage claim promoted.
